title: [AI] fix: Preserve disappearing split payees (in account) after posting transactions
issueTitle: [Bug]: Converted schedule is incorrect for split transactions with multiple payees
why: Reproducing this needs a transaction with a future date, which the rules forbid, and the flow (build a split with two payees, convert it to a schedule, post it from the Schedules list, then check the child payees) cannot fit in 2 to 6 steps.
